_shape: brand_slug -> { colourway name: colour family, or null }
_null_means: reviewed, and the name genuinely states no colour (a fabric, a collab, a place) — it drops off the audit list instead of coming back every run
_families: black, blue, brown, green, grey, multi, orange, pink, purple, red, white, yellow
_matching: exact name, whitespace-collapsed and case-insensitive; a ruling wins over the patterns in normalize.py
_stale: a ruling nothing matched this run is printed by normalize.py and listed at /internal/
